	endDate = value.values.filters.endDate
	interval = value.values.filters.interval
	agg = None

	dataItems = value.values.dataItems

	self.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Getting data item data...", "type": "INFO"}		
	
	dcis = ','.join([item.replace('dci_','') for item in dataItems])
	data, msg = kpiMatrix.analysis.getIntervalData(startDate, endDate, dcis, interval, ignoreZero, None, None)
	
	self.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}

import math
	
	ids = [int(k.split('_')[1]) for k in value.dataItems]
	
	records = kanoa.core.utilities.convert.convertDatasetToJSON(value.dataValues)
	itemData = kanoa.core.utilities.convert.convertDatasetToJSON(value.itemData)
	
	dataRecords = [r for r in records if r['data_configuration_id'] in ids]
#	return dataRecords
	
	itemInfo = {}
	
	for r in records:
		rId = r['data_configuration_id']
		
		if not rId in ids: continue
		
		rKey = 'dci_{}'.format(rId)
		
		rMin = 9e99
		rMax = -9e99
		
		for i in itemData:
			if not i.has_key(rKey): continue
			n = i[rKey]
			
			if n is None: continue
			
			if n > rMax: rMax = n
			if n < rMin: rMin = n
		
		rDelta = rMax - rMin
		
		try:
			rLog10 = int(math.log10(rDelta))
		except:
			rLog10 = 0
		
		unit = r['Unit']
		label = value.dataItems[rKey]
		
		itemInfo[rKey] = {
			'id': rId,
			'min': rMin,
			'max': rMax,
			'delta': rDelta,
			'log10': rLog10,
			'unit': unit,
			'label': label
		}
	
	return itemInfo

data = value.data
	if data.rowCount == 0: return []

	chartList = []
	values = []
	dataItems = self.params.values.dataItems
	
	cols = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(data)
	for j, row in enumerate(data):
		record = {}
		for i in range(2, len(cols)):
			record[dataItems[cols[i]]] = row[i]
			values.append(row[i])
		
		record['time'] = row['Actual_End']
		chartList.append(record)

	self.custom.timeSeries.values = values	

	return [{"name": 'Checks', "data": chartList}]

config.script:
data = system.dataset.toDataSet(self.view.custom.itemData)

	colHdrs = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(data)
	for col in range(2,len(colHdrs)):
		dci = int(colHdrs[col].replace('dci_',''))
		for dataItem in self.view.custom.dataItems:
			if dci == dataItem['data_configuration_id']:
				colHdrs[col] = dataItem['path'].replace('\\',' ')
				break

	data.setColumnNames(colHdrs)

	showHeaderRow = True
	nullsEmpty = True

	fileName = 'tableData ' + system.date.format(system.date.now(),'yyyy-MM-dd')
	data = system.dataset.toExcel(showHeaderRow, [data], nullsEmpty)
	system.perspective.download(fileName  + '.xlsx', data)

	return

def buildColumn(field, label, render):
		return {
				  "field": field,
				  "visible": True,
				  "editable": False,
				  "render": render,
				  "justify": "auto",
				  "align": "center",
				  "resizable": True,
				  "sortable": True,
				  "sort": "none",
				  "boolean": "checkbox",
				  "number": "value",
				  "nullFormat": {"includeNullStrings": False, "strict": False, "nullFormatValue": ""},
				  "numberFormat": "0,0.##",
				  "dateFormat": "MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss",
				  "width": "",
				  "strictWidth": False,
				  "header": {"title": label, "justify": "left", "align": "center", "style": {"classes": ""}},
				  "style": {"classes": ""}
				}

	cols = []
	cols.append(buildColumn("Actual_Start", 'Start', 'date'))

	colHdrs = system.dataset.getColumnHeaders(value)
	colHdrs.pop(colHdrs.index('Actual_Start'))

	for col in colHdrs:
		dci = int(col.replace('dci_',''))

		for dataItem in self.view.custom.dataItems:
			if dci == dataItem['data_configuration_id']:
				label = dataItem['path'].replace('\\',' ')
				break
		cols.append(buildColumn(col, label, 'auto'))
		
	return cols
